comment: Escalation triggers are useful but mainly cover scope, resource use, conflict, security incidents, and funding constraints. Clinical-safety risks, persistent data-quality failures, legal non-compliance, supplier failure, and inequitable access are missing.

anchor.note: p.57 l.Lines 362-371 read as the printed page; section 3.4.4 agrees

public.text: Escalation triggers are useful but mainly cover scope, resource use, conflict, security incidents, and funding constraints. Clinical-safety risks, persistent data-quality failures, legal non-compliance, supplier failure, and inequitable access are missing.
public.suggestedRevision: Add escalation triggers for clinical-safety risk, serious privacy violations, systemic data-quality problems, legal or regulatory non-compliance, supplier insolvency or lock-in, prolonged service failure, and identified discriminatory impacts.
